6. Lamp Audio, and LED Test One or more lights won't go on, indicating a defective light bulb.

No engine thrust or crash sound means volume control too low, a defective speaker, loose speaker wires, or a problem in the audio circuitry. Engine thrust sound increases with each light from right to left. With Training Mission light on, you'll hear instead the crash sound. Now adjust volume for your location.

One or both of the Select and Start switches do not flash on, indicating bad LED switches or loose harness wires. Between the end and beginning of the four-light sequence, both Select and Start switches go on in unison for a moment.
